subject: GreenLoop renewal: staggered acceptance windows + invoice fallthrough plan
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@greenloop.io>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@greenloop.io
Date: 2027-05-30T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + term change request (AWS private offer)

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well — we’re finalizing our cloud commitments for H2 and wanted to check whether Redwood can accommodate two changes for our upcoming renewal:

1) Move from a 12-month to an 18-month term (to align with our planning cadence).
2) Add a 30% capacity top-up at signing to cover new customer growth we expect in Q3.

We have an internal procurement deadline on June 10 for PO submission and need a Private Offer that can be accepted via AWS Marketplace (GreenLoop prefers a PO flow + invoice).

Can you share a short acceptance & billing plan we can circulate to our finance/procurement team? Also will need a formal Private Offer doc and a one-page summary of invoice/fallthrough behavior if they accept the offer in phases.

Attaching our internal forecast and the procurement template for reference.

Thanks —
Olivia
Olivia Park
Head of Cloud Ops | GreenLoop Inc.
Attachment: GreenLoop_Forecast_Q3Q4.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@greenloop.io>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + term change request (AWS private offer)

Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads up and the materials.

Short answer: yes, we can do 18 months and a one-time 30% commitment top-up in the private offer. To keep procurement and finance happy we typically provide:

- A Private Offer PDF with term, SKU/commitment details, and acceptance instructions for AWS Marketplace.
- A signing/runbook that shows staggered acceptance windows (if GreenLoop wants to accept in two stages) and how invoicing flows in that case.
- An explicit fallthrough plan: if later acceptance of a tranche is delayed beyond the PO window we can (A) invoice at acceptance, or (B) allow a 30-day provisional grace and bill on the next invoice cycle — we’ll call this out.

I’ve looped in Marissa (legal) to advise on the language for the Private Offer terms and Rafael (billing) for invoice flow. Neha will coordinate the AWS-side private offer submission.

Proposed timeline (tentative):
- Jun 2: Redwood sends PrivateOffer draft + 1-page invoice fallthrough summary.
- Jun 4: GreenLoop reviews and provides redlines.
- Jun 7: Final PO & DocuSign envelope created.
- Jun 10: Procurement submits signed PO (target).

If that timetable works I’ll push a draft today. Anything we should change about the acceptance windows (e.g., exact tranche sizes or dates)?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@greenloop.io>
Cc: rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + term change request (AWS private offer)

Hi Olivia / Jonas —

Quick legal note on tranche acceptance language: please avoid language that auto-adjusts pricing post-acceptance unless the customer explicitly requests a change. For staggered acceptance we recommend: 

- Define tranche 1 and tranche 2 quantity and dates.
- Specify that pricing is fixed for the full term once each tranche is accepted.
- Include a clause for re-pricing only if there’s a material change in SKU/usage profile (we can define thresholds).

I’ve attached a short terms doc with suggested wording and a redline-ready Private Offer template (RI_PrivateOffer_Terms_v3.docx).

Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
Attachment: RI_PrivateOffer_Terms_v3.docx (doc)
From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@greenloop.io>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: olivia.park <olivia.park@greenloop.io>, procurement@greenloop.io
Date: 2027-06-02T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + term change request (AWS private offer)

Jonas / Marissa — thanks, that timeline helps. A few clarifying items from procurement: 

1) Tranche sizes: we want Tranche A = 70% of the total commitment, Tranche B = 30% (B expected 45 days after A).
2) Billing preference: GreenLoop prefers a single consolidated invoice for the full amount split by acceptance date (rather than two invoices) — is that possible?
3) PO label: procurement requires the Private Offer to reference their internal PO number GL-2027-418 so our finance system can match.

If you can confirm the invoice approach and include the PO label in the Private Offer we’re comfortable moving forward with the June 10 PO deadline.

Thanks —
Daniel Kim
Senior Procurement Manager | GreenLoop Inc.
From: rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: daniel.kim <daniel.kim@greenloop.io>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-03T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + term change request (AWS private offer)

Daniel / Olivia —

We can support your preferred billing flow with one consolidated invoice showing both tranche acceptances, provided the acceptance dates are captured on the DocuSign envelope and the Private Offer references GL-2027-418. Operational notes below: 

- Invoice creation: we’ll generate one invoice dated at the final acceptance date but line-item the two tranches with their respective acceptance dates.
- Accounting: to avoid recognition mismatch, GreenLoop should confirm whether they need revenue recognition at acceptance A or at final acceptance. If they prefer recognition at acceptance A we will split the invoice into two; otherwise one consolidated invoice is fine.
- Payment terms: standard Net 30 unless you request otherwise (we can mark Net 45 in the PO if needed).

Jonas — I’ve attached a quick schedule spreadsheet (GreenLoop_Acceptance_Window_Schedule.xlsx) and I’ll prep the final DocuSign package once Marissa signs off on the Private Offer language.

-Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Director, Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
Attachment: GreenLoop_Acceptance_Window_Schedule.xlsx (xlsx)
